title: Highlight Member Results
content:
## Highlight Member Results


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000058553


## Overview


Provide certain members with an additional benefit – standing out amongst the crowd within the website’s search results. Highlight members of specific membership levels within the member search result pages of the website. Further differentiate members from different membership tiers by changing the highlight colors and design for each of them.

```
How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Highlight Member Results Add-On
```


## Enabling the Add-On


1. Go to Finance - Membership Plans:

2. Click Edit on the membership level the admin wish to add this to:

3. In the Search Visibility tab scroll all the way down until the option Highlight Member Profiles shows:

Then choose Yes to enable it:

The admin will be able to make changes and see the preview on the right side:

This will display depending on what the admin has selected to show across photo or above photo:

If there are more questions about this, feel free to create a ticket HERE.
